concerns.text: Task T013d-1, T013d-2, and T013d-3 are too coarse. T013d-1 combines fetching sessions AND extracting timestamp columns; T013d-2 combines sorting AND extracting the 'next item' label. These should be split into distinct atomic tasks (e.g., 'Extract timestamp column', 'Sort sessions', 'Extract next item') to allow independent verification and parallel execution.

Task T017 is too coarse. It requires implementing two distinct formulas (SRC and PSA) and applying them to two different path sets (Greedy and Beam). This should be split into: 1) Implement SRC function, 2) Implement PSA function, 3) Apply rectification to Greedy paths, 4) Apply rectification to Beam paths.

Task T024 is too coarse. It requires running the full evaluation pipeline, generating two specific JSON files, AND verifying their schema. The verification step should be a separate task or a test case, not part of the implementation task description.

Task T030 is too coarse. It aggregates results from three different upstream tasks (T025b, T028b, T029b) and generates a single report. This should be split into: 1) Aggregate significance results, 2) Aggregate sensitivity results, 3) Generate final statistical_report.json.

Task T032 is too coarse. It requires writing a markdown file with six specific sections. This should be split into: 1) Implement report header/methodology generation, 2) Implement results table generation, 3) Implement statistical/sensitivity sections, 4) Assemble final report.

Task T005a and T005b are redundant. T005a creates directories, T005b adds .gitkeep. These can be combined into a single task 'Create data directory structure with .gitkeep files' to reduce task count without losing granularity.
